name: alphanova
description: Research Indian and global markets with AlphaNova quotes, fundamentals, news, stock screens, delivery data and institutional flows.

interface.longDescription: Search companies, compare available quotes, inspect price history and fundamentals, find dated news, screen Nifty 500 stocks and review NSE delivery and institutional flows. Public research only; no brokerage execution or access to browser-local portfolios.
defaultPrompt: Use AlphaNova to compare Reliance and TCS with source dates.
Find Nifty 500 stocks meeting AlphaNova’s 20-day breakout screen.
Summarize the latest available Indian market breadth and institutional flows.

positive.description: Resolve an NSE listing and compare quotes across currencies
positive.prompt: Use AlphaNova to find Reliance Industries on NSE and compare its latest available quote with AAPL. Include the currency and quote time for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Reliance Industries to RELIANCE.NS and present available quotes with their original currencies, quote times, and delay indicators.

positive.description: Read a bounded slice of daily price history and report delivery data
positive.prompt: Use AlphaNova to show the five latest daily OHLCV bars from the one-month range for RELIANCE.NS and its latest available NSE delivery figures.
positive.expected_behavior: Show up to five bars with dates and currency, identify any truncation, and report available delivery quantity and percentage with the delivery session date.

positive.description: Distinguish reported fundamentals from published company research
positive.prompt: Use AlphaNova to summarize reported fundamentals and the latest published Lodestar assessment for RELIANCE.NS. Include the dates and identify missing values.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the periods and sources of available financials and the date of the published assessment. Preserve missing values and summarize the recorded evidence and risks.

positive.description: Summarize Nifty 500 breadth and NSE institutional activity
positive.prompt: Use AlphaNova to summarize the latest available Nifty 500 market breadth and NSE institutional flows. Give the date of each dataset.
positive.expected_behavior: Report available breadth, coverage, FII/DII activity and participant positioning with their respective source dates. Surface any partial source failures.

positive.description: Run a Nifty 500 screen and retrieve source-linked company headlines
positive.prompt: Use AlphaNova to show up to two results from the Nifty 500 20-day breakout screen and separately list the two latest available headlines for RELIANCE.NS.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the preset, session date, match count and up to two screen rows. Present any returned headlines with their publication dates and original links.

negative.description: The read-only server cannot submit or confirm brokerage orders
negative.prompt: Use AlphaNova to place a market order for 100 shares of RELIANCE.NS in my brokerage account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that AlphaNova cannot access brokerage accounts or place orders. Make no claim that an order was placed.

negative.description: The server cannot access browser-local portfolio data
negative.prompt: Use AlphaNova to open the holdings I saved in the AlphaNova website and list their quantities and cost basis.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the holdings are stored in the user's browser and ask the user to provide the relevant records if they want an analysis.

negative.description: The on-demand Lodestar scoring engine is outside plugin scope
negative.prompt: Use AlphaNova to generate a brand-new on-demand Lodestar score for AAPL, without using any existing published assessment.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin can retrieve existing published assessments where available. Do not fabricate a new Lodestar score.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with ten read-only market research tools and a bundled research workflow.
